name: kyro-sprint-flow
description: Orchestrates Kyro sprint flow via executor/QA workers; follows Kyro next step

changes: Initial release: Kyro orchestrator skill that directs isolated executor, QA, and fix workers
Orchestrator never loads kyro-sprint-executor, kyro-task-context, or kyro-qa
Structured return contracts for executor and QA workers; flow state passed explicitly
User authorization gate before first QA; re-QA after fixes follows KYRO NEXT STEP
Fix Plan generated from QA findings; fix→QA loop capped at 3 rounds
State-guided routing via KYRO NEXT STEP rather than a hardcoded execute→QA→fix machine
